_doc: v8.12 🔎 Gold auto-scanner (Orangie 'Memecoin Digester' style). tools/gold.py scans public lists every run, keeps coins that pass a filter, runs the Gold DD on them, tags the card '🔎 Filtr: …' and (if alert) queues a Gold push. Tune numbers here; no code change needed. Pre = DexScreener pair data (mcap, liq, h1 %, vol1h, ageH = pair age, dex, buys1h). Post = after the DD (metrics from gold-rules.js); a hit that fails post is dropped.

filters.pl: Świeżo zmigrowany z pump.fun (< 1 h), MC ≥ $75K, prawdziwi holderzy
filters.en: Fresh pump.fun graduate (< 1 h), MC ≥ $75K, real holders

filters.pl: Wolumen 1 h ≥ 50% MC, +20% w 1 h, MC $250K–$5M
filters.en: 1 h volume ≥ 50% of MC, +20% in 1 h, MC $250K–$5M
